pairing.why: Rainn Wilson brings the mystery and animation; Tracy Morgan brings the music and family; fans of both share a taste for drama, comedy, actor and comedian.

copy.title: Comp line
copy.body: Rainn Wilson meets Tracy Morgan. Dry, character-driven comedy from one, family warmth and a comedian's voice from the other, with a shared taste for drama and comedy.
copy.hint: The one-line "X meets Y" that opens every pitch.
copy.author: llm

copy.title: Booking pitch
copy.body: Sunday Best is a clean, family-first stand-up hour about church potlucks, overbearing aunts and raising teenagers. Its audience is the one that loves Cedric the Entertainer, Nate Bargatze, Jim Gaffigan and Tim Hawkins. Comps: Rainn Wilson (fit 0.95, Top 1%) and Tracy Morgan (fit 0.87, Top 4%) give the mainstream reach. Brian Regan (fit 0.98), Mike Birbiglia (fit 0.94) and Jeff Foxworthy (fit 0.91) show the core stand-up fans are already there. Strongholds in Spokane, Salt Lake City, Eugene and Dallas make routing simple, and Missoula and Boise look like hidden gems. Affinity is aggregate taste, not a forecast, but the overlap is consistent across every comp.
copy.hint: Comps and audience for a club, festival or special pitch.
copy.author: llm

copy.title: Who it's for
copy.body: The audience skews older: 45–54 over-indexes at +0.52 and 55+ at +0.43, while 25–34 sits below average. Gender is close to even, leaning slightly male (0.15). Their tastes run to comedians, comedy, positive and encouraging material. They also like NEEDTOBREATHE, Dave Barnes and Mat Kearney, podcasts such as You Made It Weird with Pete Holmes and Gettin' Better with Ron Funches, and brands like Target and Chick-fil-A.
copy.hint: A short, evidence-backed paragraph about the audience.
copy.author: llm

copy.title: For fans of
copy.body: For fans of Cedric the Entertainer, Nate Bargatze, Jim Gaffigan and Tim Hawkins, and anyone who likes Brian Regan or Jeff Foxworthy without the language.
copy.hint: A one-liner for bios, store pages, press kits and posts.
copy.author: llm

copy.title: Ad hooks
copy.body:
• Rainn Wilson fans: Stories with a dry, observational streak, set at a church potluck.
• Brian Regan fans: Clean stand-up built on family chaos, from the teenager at the table to the aunt running it.
• Jeff Foxworthy fans: Family and faith-adjacent humor that keeps it clean and still lands, with the people you grew up around.
copy.hint: Three hooks, each aimed at fans of one comp.

kit.headline: Cedric the Entertainer, Nate Bargatze, Jim Gaffigan and Tim Hawkins fans are the room for Sunday Best, a clean family stand-up hour that sits beside Rainn Wilson and Tracy Morgan on the taste graph.
kit.summary: Sunday Best sits in clean, family-first stand-up, with strong fit to Brian Regan (0.98), Mike Birbiglia (0.94) and Jeff Foxworthy (0.91). The audience skews 45–54 (+0.52) and 55+ (+0.43), and under-indexes under 35. Lead with the Rainn Wilson and Tracy Morgan pairing for reach, and back it with Brian Regan and Mike Birbiglia for the closest taste match. Pitch strongholds like Spokane, Salt Lake City, Eugene and Dallas first.
